messages:
sam.sales: FYI Nova wants to close POC this week but procurement pushed back on two things: HSM in DPA and Net60 payment terms. they asked if we can give 10-day POC access before PO.

claire.legal: legal needs (1) redline MSA to cap liability, (2) DPA updated to include HSM attestation and subproc notice, (3) confirm export control clause. i'll prepare a short amendment.

nova.poc: confirmed. our security team requires an HSM attestation and evidence of key separation. procurement says PO after exec countersign; they can approve 10-day non-billable trial only.

eli.eng: we can offer Private POC in their VPC with KMS integration or Dedicated bound to an HSM. ops needs endpoint and certs; setup ~48h after receipt. i'll draft the KMS checklist.

marco.finance: Net60 without PO needs VP waiver. standard is PO before provisioning. if Sales wants exception, submit waiver and include billing contact and invoice milestones on orderform.

zoe.solutions: suggested compromise: sign MSA+orderform with a clause: "10-day trial on execution; provisioning contingent on PO within 30 days; no paid resources billed until PO." keeps finance safe and lets them test.

claire.legal: that clause works. i'll add: "suspension limited to trial resources and not a breach." will upload redline MSA+DPA by EOD and request HSM attestation template from compliance.

sam.sales: thanks all. next steps: @claire.legal upload PDFs, @eli.eng post KMS checklist, @marco.finance confirm invoice milestone language, i'll create DocuSign envelopes to purchasing@nova.com and cc secops@nova.com.
